parameters.content:
## GitHub issue triage
Labels new GitHub issues (bug, feature, question) and comments with what is missing. It never closes anything.

**Setup:** add your credentials to each node, replace every REPLACE_ME, then test with one item before activating.

**Guardrails:** Adds a label and one comment only. Issue text is treated as untrusted data.

No secrets are stored in this file.
